text:
alex: Heads up — saw latency tail spike (~300ms p99) on prod for long-context chats. Correlation: KV pager kicking in + evictions. Repro window: sustained 6k-token contexts. @maria can you look?

infra-bot: alert: kv-evictor high CPU on gw-12, 2287654321

maria: looking. initial profile shows evicter threads hitting mutex backoff and doing frequent FIFO→LRU flips. :thinking_face:

cheng: Do we have a repro script? sounds like reuse window too small causing reinsert churn

alex: I ran a small repro on staging, gist below, spits out eviction counts per second:
```
./tools/kv_stress --tokens 6000 --clients 100 --duration 5m
```
Observed pattern: eviction bursts every ~20s that coincide with a batch size spike.

sam: interesting — batching heuristics ramp up batch sizes when queue depth > 32 which increases parallel KV reads/writes. If evictor is FIFO we might reinsert same keys quickly and thrash.

nina: @sam good point. also saw kernel selection CPU hotpath get scheduled off GPUs in that window, increasing token latency. probably compounding.

maria: profiling snippet (perf top): `evictor::try_evict`, `kv_entry::refcount`, `pager::page_lock`. Stack shows heavy time in `std::vec::drain` during reordering.

cheng: Correctness check: any chance eviction returns stale KV handles that get reused across threads? Did we protect the reuse window under the same lock?

alex: I instrumented reuse-window checks — in LRU path we drop ref then readd, which creates a small gap. In high concurrency gap becomes visible -> observed "ghost hits" where KV value mismatch for 1-2 requests.

sam: That's a bug then. We should make reuse an atomic bump without dropping ref, or change to RCU-like pattern.

maria: Mitigation steps: 1) short term: add jitter to eviction timer + lower batch growth threshold. 2) medium: make reuse bump atomic. 3) long: add eviction-sampling and metric to track ghost hits.

nina: Can someone open a perf/regression ticket and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml? I'll push staging config with jitter.

alex: I'll create the ticket and attach the flamegraphs. Also adding a small unit test for reuse races.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: config change `evict_jitter_ms=150` applied to staging (deploy 2287654400).

sam: :thumbsup: sounds good. Let's also add a microbenchmark to the CI to catch this.

maria: I'll PR the atomic bump + tests today. tagging @cheng for review on correctness model.

cheng: got it — will review. quick follow-up: should we push FIFO-only experiment to prod to see if FIFO reduces churn? I can run A/B in staging.

alex: Prefer avoid prod A/B until we fix correctness. Staging experiments fine.

nina: timeline: hotfix to staging now, PRs by EOD, smoke run tomorrow. Thanks all.
